gloss: residual heat; remaining warmth; lingering heat

definitions.gloss: residual heat; remaining warmth; lingering heat
definitions.explanation: Heat that remains in an object, vessel, or space after the heat source has been removed. Commonly referenced in cooking to describe using lingering heat to finish cooking food.

examples.japanese: {残熱|ざんねつ}で{卵|たまご}に{火|ひ}を{通|とお}す。
examples.english: Cook the egg through with the residual heat.

examples.japanese: {火|ひ}を{消|け}した{後|あと}も、フライパンの{残熱|ざんねつ}で{調理|ちょうり}が{進|すす}む。
examples.english: Even after turning off the heat, the residual heat in the frying pan continues cooking.

examples.japanese: パスタは{茹|ゆ}で{上|あ}がる{一分前|いっぷんまえ}にお{湯|ゆ}から{上|あ}げて、ソースの{残熱|ざんねつ}で{絡|から}めると{美味|おい}しく{仕上|しあ}がる。
examples.english: If you take the pasta out of the water one minute before it's done and toss it using the residual heat of the sauce, it turns out delicious.

notes:
Heat that remains in an object or space after the heat source has been removed. Commonly used in cooking to describe using residual heat to finish cooking food, and also in engineering or industrial contexts for heat retained in machinery or buildings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {残熱|ざんねつ}で{火|ひ}を{通|とお}す: to cook through with residual heat
- {残熱|ざんねつ}を{利用|りよう}する: to make use of residual heat
- {残熱|ざんねつ}で{仕上|しあ}げる: to finish with residual heat
- {残熱|ざんねつ}が{残|のこ}る: residual heat lingers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {余熱|よねつ}: residual heat — synonymous; {余熱|よねつ} is more commonly used in cooking contexts
- {廃熱|はいねつ}: waste heat — heat discarded from industrial or mechanical processes
